minecraft:gateway_beam.description: In the End, a gateway nearby fires its beam with no one near it.

minecraft:chorus_shift.name: Chorus Shift
minecraft:chorus_shift.description: In the End, chorus plants and flowers nearby look to be a block over from where they grew. Only this player sees it.

minecraft:phantom_egg.name: Phantom Egg
minecraft:phantom_egg.description: In the End, a dragon egg sits on the ground near the player where there is none. A click shows the truth.

minecraft:ender_chests_open.name: Ender Chests Open
minecraft:ender_chests_open.description: In the End, ender chests open all around the player, one after another, and shut. There are no chests.

minecraft:nowhere_portal.name: Portal to Nowhere
minecraft:nowhere_portal.description: In the Overworld, a lit nether portal in an obsidian frame stands in the open near the player. It leads nowhere, and a click shows empty air.

minecraft:enderman_home_block.name: Block from Home
minecraft:enderman_home_block.description: In the End, an enderman stands off with a block from the player's own pack in its hands. It is gone when looked at or approached.

minecraft:desert_husk_haze.name: Husk in the Haze
minecraft:desert_husk_haze.description: A husk stands far off in the desert heat, and is gone when you come near.

minecraft:desert_sand_trickle.name: Trickling Sand
minecraft:desert_sand_trickle.description: Sand trickles down from the ceiling above you in the desert.

minecraft:desert_plate_click.name: Plate Underfoot
minecraft:desert_plate_click.description: A stone pressure plate clicks nearby in the desert, with no plate there.

minecraft:swamp_lily_drift.name: Drifting Lily Pad
minecraft:swamp_lily_drift.description: A lily pad glides toward you across the swamp, then returns.

minecraft:cauldron.name: Bubbling Cauldron
minecraft:cauldron.description: A cauldron in the swamp bubbles by itself.

minecraft:fireflies_dark.name: Dark Fireflies
minecraft:fireflies_dark.description: The firefly bushes around you look like plain bushes for a while.

minecraft:snow_door_drift.name: Snow Against the Door
minecraft:snow_door_drift.description: Snow piles up against the outside of a door, then melts away.

minecraft:snow_snowball.name: Snowball from Nowhere
minecraft:snow_snowball.description: A snowball flies at you from nobody in the snow.

minecraft:snow_powder_path.name: Powder Snow Path
minecraft:snow_powder_path.description: The ground ahead turns to powder snow, a block deep, then hardens again.

minecraft:mountain_avalanche.name: Avalanche
minecraft:mountain_avalanche.description: A rumble and a cloud of snow fall from a distant mountainside.

minecraft:mountain_wind_push.name: Howling Wind
minecraft:mountain_wind_push.description: Wind howls at a cliff edge and pushes you toward it.

minecraft:ocean_ship_bell.name: Ship's Bell
minecraft:ocean_ship_bell.description: A ship's bell tolls from the open sea.

minecraft:boat_grabbed.name: Grabbed Boat
minecraft:boat_grabbed.description: Out at sea, the boat the player sits in stops dead for eight seconds while drowned groan under the water.

minecraft:parrots_scatter.name: Parrots Scatter
minecraft:parrots_scatter.description: In the jungle, every wild parrot nearby takes wing at once and flies away from the player.

minecraft:window_vines.name: Vines on the Window
minecraft:window_vines.description: In the jungle, vines grow beside the glass of a nearby window. They wither again after a minute.

minecraft:mooshroom_brown.name: Brown Mooshrooms
minecraft:mooshroom_brown.description: On the mushroom fields, the red mooshrooms nearby turn brown, then red again after half a minute.

minecraft:eyeblossoms_open.name: Eyes Behind You
minecraft:eyeblossoms_open.description: In the pale garden, closed eyeblossoms outside the player's view are shown open, so they are open when the player turns.

minecraft:creaking_heart_call.name: Creaking in the Trees
minecraft:creaking_heart_call.description: In an ordinary forest, a creaking heart sounds three times from somewhere among the trees.

minecraft:resin_clumps.name: Resin on the Walls
minecraft:resin_clumps.description: In a forest, resin clumps grow on the wall of a nearby house. They are gone again after two minutes.

minecraft:black_petals.name: Black Petals
minecraft:black_petals.description: In the cherry grove, ash drifts down around the player like falling petals.

minecraft:canopy_closes.name: Closing Canopy
minecraft:canopy_closes.description: In the dark forest, the gaps in the canopy overhead look filled with leaves. Only the player sees it.

minecraft:sculk_creep.name: Creeping Sculk
minecraft:sculk_creep.description: In the deep dark, sculk spreads over the ground toward the player, one block at a time. It is gone again after two minutes.

minecraft:berries_dark.name: Berries Go Dark
minecraft:berries_dark.description: In the lush caves, the glow berries nearby lose their glow one after another, and grow back after a minute.

minecraft:roof_figure.name: Figure on the Roof
minecraft:roof_figure.description: Another player in a default skin crouches on a roof some way off, watching the player. It vanishes when the player comes close or after a while.

minecraft:hill_waver.name: Wave from the Hill
minecraft:hill_waver.description: Another player in a default skin stands on a hilltop in the distance and waves, facing the player. It vanishes when the player comes close or after a while.

minecraft:wall_miner.name: Mining Through the Wall
minecraft:wall_miner.description: Another player in a default skin mines the wall in front of the player from the far side, with cracks and digging sounds. The wall is not broken.

minecraft:table_figure.name: Figure at the Crafting Table
minecraft:table_figure.description: Another player in a default skin stands at a crafting table nearby, looking down at it. It vanishes when the player comes close or after a while.

minecraft:cave_torches.name: Torches Nobody Placed
minecraft:cave_torches.description: A line of torches the player never placed shows up along a dark tunnel ahead, then goes. Only this player sees them.

minecraft:own_walker.name: Own Walker
minecraft:own_walker.description: A figure in the player's own skin walks across their view far away. It vanishes when the player comes close, when there is no way on, or after a while.

minecraft:night_runner.name: Runner in the Dark
minecraft:night_runner.description: In the dark, another player in a default skin sprints across the path ahead, jumping now and then, and is gone when the player gets close.

minecraft:bed_sleeper.name: Sleeper in the Bed
minecraft:bed_sleeper.description: Another player in a default skin lies asleep in a free bed nearby, which stays unchanged. It vanishes when the player comes close or after a while.

minecraft:shrieker_figure.name: Figure by the Shrieker
minecraft:shrieker_figure.description: In the deep dark, another player in a default skin crouches by a sculk shrieker. It vanishes when the shrieker shrieks, when the player comes close or after a while.

minecraft:hello_chat.name: Hello in Chat
minecraft:hello_chat.description: A chat line from a made-up player name, such as "hello?", seen only by this player.

minecraft:ghost_teleport.name: Teleported ???
minecraft:ghost_teleport.description: The command feedback "Teleported ??? to <player>" in chat, seen only by this player. Nothing is moved.

minecraft:stranger_advancement.name: Stranger's Advancement
minecraft:stranger_advancement.description: A chat line that a made-up player has made an advancement such as [Who's There?], seen only by this player.

minecraft:grave_figure.name: Figure at the Grave
minecraft:grave_figure.description: Another player in a default skin stands where the player last died, facing them. It vanishes when the player comes close or after a while.

minecraft:bedside_figure.name: Figure by the Bed
minecraft:bedside_figure.description: After the player wakes, another player in a default skin stands next to the bed for a second and is gone.

restless:scarecrow_closer.name: Scarecrow Closer
restless:scarecrow_closer.description: A scarecrow nearby is standing a step closer than it was. It goes back after a minute.

restless:ouija_hi.name: Ouija Greeting
restless:ouija_hi.description: With a ouija board nearby, the planchette spells a greeting on its own. Nobody asked.

restless:spirit_box_word.name: Unasked Word
restless:spirit_box_word.description: A spirit box nearby says a word without being spoken to.

restless:salt_gap.name: Gap in the Salt
restless:salt_gap.description: One cell of a salt line goes missing, the one closest to the spirit. It is back after two minutes.

restless:grave_name.name: Your Name on the Stone
restless:grave_name.description: A gravestone nearby reads your own name.

restless:journal_page_torn.name: Torn Page
restless:journal_page_torn.description: One entry vanishes from your journal for a few minutes, then is back where it was.

restless:dreamcatcher_fails.name: Failed Dreamcatcher
restless:dreamcatcher_fails.description: A dreamcatcher nearby swings hard, and the dream comes anyway.

restless:lantern_soul_fire.name: Soul Fire Lantern
restless:lantern_soul_fire.description: A hallowed lantern burns with soul fire for half a minute while a spirit is about. It does not ward then.

restless:charm_falls.name: Fallen Charm
restless:charm_falls.description: A door charm nearby drops off as an item.

restless:altar_midnight.name: Midnight Candles
restless:altar_midnight.description: At night the candles around an altar nearby light themselves, one after another.

minecraft:brewing_swap.name: Brewing Swap
minecraft:brewing_swap.description: A potion in a brewing stand nearby turns into another one. It is put back after five minutes if nobody touched it.

minecraft:brewing_bubbles.name: Brewing Bubbles
minecraft:brewing_bubbles.description: An empty brewing stand bubbles and brews as if something were in it.

minecraft:beacon_out.name: Beacon Out
minecraft:beacon_out.description: The beam of a beacon goes out or turns black. Only you see it, for half a minute.

minecraft:statue_pose.name: Statue Pose
minecraft:statue_pose.description: A copper golem statue behind your back stands in another pose when you turn to look. It stays that way for a couple of minutes.

minecraft:note_tune.name: Note Tune
minecraft:note_tune.description: The note blocks nearby play a short tune nobody played.

minecraft:campfire_cooks.name: Campfire Cooks
minecraft:campfire_cooks.description: Something nobody put there is cooking on a campfire: rotten flesh or a rabbit foot. Only you see it, for a minute.

minecraft:spawner_shows.name: Spawner Shows
minecraft:spawner_shows.description: The creature spinning inside a monster spawner is another one: a villager, a cat, a golem. Only you see it, for half a minute.

minecraft:trial_ominous.name: Trial Ominous
minecraft:trial_ominous.description: A trial spawner turns ominous for a few seconds. Only you see it.

minecraft:vault_head.name: Vault Head
minecraft:vault_head.description: A vault shows your own head as its reward. Only you see it, for half a minute.

minecraft:black_bed.name: Black Bed
minecraft:black_bed.description: A bed nearby turns black. Only you see it, for a minute.

minecraft:black_carpets.name: Black Carpets
minecraft:black_carpets.description: The carpets in the room turn black. Only you see it, for a minute.

minecraft:black_ash.name: Black Ash
minecraft:black_ash.description: Black ash falls inside the house, from a ceiling that has nothing to burn.

minecraft:border_closes.name: Closing Border
minecraft:border_closes.description: A world border shrinks around the player on their screen for a few seconds, though none is there.

minecraft:false_recipe.name: False Recipe
minecraft:false_recipe.description: A "recipe unlocked" toast appears for a recipe of bones and a skull that does not exist.

minecraft:view_narrows.name: Narrowing View
minecraft:view_narrows.description: The field of view pinches for a second, as if the player were slowed.

minecraft:portal_swirl.name: Portal Swirl
minecraft:portal_swirl.description: The nether portal swirl fills the screen for a moment, though no portal is there.

minecraft:line_pulls.name: The Line Pulls
minecraft:line_pulls.description: While fishing, the line drags the player a step toward the water.

minecraft:odd_catch.name: Odd Catch
minecraft:odd_catch.description: The catch is the player's own head or a bone, thrown out of the water.
